summary: The old harness reaches printing only through parsed JSON. It cannot exercise the new nesting rejection in either printer, and it already cannot exercise raw values nested in arrays or objects.

coverage_evidence.dependency_reason: The supplied recipe builds the cJSON library and links this fuzz entry point.
The build path is unchanged after the source change.

claims.necessity_reason: A finite array tree deeper than the configured limit can be constructed with the public array APIs. The new printer rejects it, but parsing rejects that depth before the old harness can print it.

before.requirement: Print an array tree without a printer nesting rejection at this depth.
before.reason: The array printer has no nesting rejection before the change.

after.requirement: Reach the array printer's supported rejection when its output depth is at least CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT.
after.reason: The printer now returns false at the limit. The parser rejects an array at that input depth, and the harness prints only a successfully parsed tree; it never constructs a deeper tree.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Parsing rejects arrays before their nesting depth can reach the printer's new rejection.
Defines the shared nesting limit.
Public constructors provide a supported way to make an array tree.
The public append operation can connect the constructed array nodes.

claims.comparison_reason: The rejection is added by g0001; the fixed harness has no route to a tree deep enough to trigger it.

claims.necessity_reason: A finite object tree deeper than the configured limit can be constructed with public APIs. The new object printer rejects it, but the old harness cannot supply such a tree through parsing.

before.requirement: Print an object tree without a printer nesting rejection at this depth.
before.reason: The object printer has no nesting rejection before the change.

after.requirement: Reach the object printer's supported rejection when its output depth is at least CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT.
after.reason: The parser rejects an object at that depth. The harness prints only successfully parsed trees and has no construction path.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Parsing rejects objects at the same nesting limit.
Defines the shared nesting limit.
Public constructors provide a supported way to make an object tree.
The public append operation can connect the constructed object nodes.

claims.comparison_reason: The rejection is added by g0002; the fixed harness has no route to a tree deep enough to trigger it.

claims.necessity_reason: The array printer supports a raw child value, but the parser never creates cJSON_Raw and the harness has no construction path.

before.requirement: Reach printing of an array containing a cJSON_Raw child.
before.reason: Array printing delegates each child to print_value, which supports raw values. The harness obtains children only by parsing, whose value dispatcher has no raw case.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: print_value supports emitting a raw child.
The complete parser value dispatcher never creates cJSON_Raw.
A public constructor supplies the supported raw child state.

after.requirement: Reach printing of an array containing a cJSON_Raw child.
after.reason: The raw printing path remains supported, while the harness still obtains trees only through the parser.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: print_value still supports emitting a raw child.
The complete parser value dispatcher still has no raw case.
The public raw constructor remains available.

claims.comparison_reason: On both sides, the same parse-only tree setup prevents a raw array child from reaching printing.

claims.necessity_reason: The object printer supports a raw member value, but the parser never creates cJSON_Raw and the harness does not construct object members.

before.requirement: Reach printing of an object containing a cJSON_Raw member value.
before.reason: Object printing delegates member values to print_value, which supports raw values. The harness supplies only parsed objects, and parsing has no raw case.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: print_value supports emitting a raw member value.
The complete parser value dispatcher has no raw case.
A public helper supplies the supported raw object member state.

after.requirement: Reach printing of an object containing a cJSON_Raw member value.
after.reason: The raw member path remains supported, and the old harness still obtains objects only through parsing.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: print_value still supports emitting a raw member value.
The complete parser value dispatcher still has no raw case.
The public helper still supplies a raw object member.

claims.comparison_reason: On both sides, the same parse-only tree setup prevents a raw object member from reaching printing.
